title: Step 2 – Create the cables and assign interfaces
cmd: sudo ip link add veth-s type veth peer name vr0; sudo ip link add vr1 type veth peer name veth-r; sudo ip link set veth-s netns sender; sudo ip link set vr0 netns router; sudo ip link set vr1 netns router; sudo ip link set veth-r netns receiver; sudo ip netns exec router ip link set vr0 name eth0; sudo ip netns exec router ip link set vr1 name eth1; sudo ip netns exec sender ip link set veth-s name eth0; sudo ip netns exec receiver ip link set veth-r name eth0; echo done
note: Sender eth0 <-> Router eth0 and Router eth1 <-> Receiver eth0 (names chosen to match the lab table).
